package.name: fetch_7dof_description
package.description:
7-DOF Fetch-style manipulator for the Gymnasium FetchPickAndPlace task: URDF, ros2_control configuration, Gazebo (gz-sim) launch file and the matching pick-and-place world (table, block, target).
The arm has exactly 7 DOF (torso is fixed, matching the Gym environment). The gripper is the two-fingered parallel jaw with 0.05 m finger travel, and the end-effector reference frame (grip_site_link) matches the robot0:grip site of the MuJoCo model.
